what: Positions placed by hand on a map and checked against the game.
holds: Coordinates nobody else publishes: BattlePass document spots, room numbers and landmark names the map does not print, hazards, interactables, extracts a source forgot — plus corrections to positions that are published but wrong.
coordinates: Coordinates are game units, matching tarkov.dev's coordinate space. `floor` is -1 when a map has no floors. Keys in the correction maps are "<map>|<label>|<x>|<z>" as the editor writes them.
excluded: Story chapters are third-party (tarkov-data-overlay) and are in api/maps.json, not here.
